steer: S002 §4-5 (census done; this lane is REUSE_MATRIX + port plan)

headline.dense_not_moe: No num_experts. Do not port moe_table_build, expert residency, device top-k, expert address tables, first-touch upload, routed/shared expert waves.
headline.hybrid_is_q80_family: 64 layers, 48 linear + 16 full, interval 4. Same 3:1 rule as Q80 DeltaNet(36)+GQA(12). Start from qwen80_hybrid_token_graph.rs, not qwen_dense.rs.
headline.deltanet_verdict: SAME recurrence as Q80 Gated DeltaNet. Port is parameterization + projection-layout adapter. Say this loudly.
headline.vision_verdict: SKIP the vision tower for bring-up. Text path stands alone.

geometry.mlp: dense SwiGLU silu, every layer, no experts

full_attention.attn_output_gate: sigmoid, fused in q_proj as [head][query 256 | gate 256]

linear_attention.conv1d_note: HF Conv1d is typically [C,1,K]. This MLX shard stores [10240,4,1]. Pack-time must verify axis order against a one-layer oracle; do not assume HF layout.

geometry.rms_norm_scale: x * rsqrt(mean(x^2)+eps) * (1 + weight); weight init zeros

param_budget.steer_allowance: 3 BPW allowed. <=1.5 tournament law does NOT apply.
param_budget.recommendation: Start uniform Q4 (~13.45 GB language) if the existing packer retargets cheaply; drop to Q3 (~10.09 GB) only if the pack is already a supported path. Do not open a 2-bit campaign.

state_budget.deltanet_recurrent_note: 48 layers × 48 value heads × 128 × 128 f32 = 144 MiB resident. Formula matches Q80 slot layout with heads=48.
state_budget.gqa_kv_note: 16 layers × 4 KV heads × 256 dim × 2 (K+V) × 4 = 128 KiB/token. 8k context ≈ 1 GiB. Do not size the first runtime to 262144.
state_budget.vs_q80_deltanet_state: Q80 is 36 × 32 × 128 × 128 f32 = 72 MiB. Q38 is exactly 2× that (144 MiB).

deliverable_2_deltanet_comparison.loud: Qwen3.8 linear_attention IS Q80 Gated DeltaNet. The port is a parameterization plus a pack-time projection fuse. Do not write a new recurrence.
evidence: transformers modeling_qwen3_5.py class Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet uses the identical torch_recurrent_gated_delta_rule as modeling/modular_qwen3_next.py Qwen3NextGatedDeltaNet.
HF docs: 'The text backbone reuses Qwen3-Next’s linear-attention decoder' and names the path Qwen3NextGatedDeltaNet / Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet with the same core.
Hawking shader crates/hawking-core/shaders/qwen_next.metal qwen_next_gated_delta_decode_single is documented as mirroring that exact rule.

shared_update: q ← l2norm(q) * 1/sqrt(d_k)     (done in rearrange; kernel receives scaled q)
if n_v / n_k > 1: repeat_interleave q and k across value heads
o ← RMSNorm(o) * silu(z)         (gated RMSNorm, no +1 residual scale)
recurrence_written_out.hawking_conv_l2: crates/hawking-core/shaders/qwen_next.metal:199-285  (depthwise SiLU conv on QKV, L2 on Q/K, repeat key heads → value heads)

what_matches_exactly: Causal depthwise conv, kernel 4, SiLU, applied to Q,K,V only (not Z).
Q/K L2 then Q scaled by 1/sqrt(d_k); K unscaled after L2.
Q/K repeated from num_key_heads to num_value_heads.
Gated RMSNorm on value-head dim 128 with silu(z), weight WITHOUT +1.
Input / post-attn RMSNorm WITH +1 residual scale.
what_differs_and_is_only_parametric: value heads 48 vs 32 (values_per_key_head 3 vs 2). Metal kernels already take key_heads / values_per_key_head / heads as buffers.
hidden 5120 vs 2048; layers 64 vs 48; GQA 24:4 vs 16:2; vocab 248320 vs 151936.
what_is_an_adapter_not_a_new_op: Q38 ships split projections in_proj_qkv / in_proj_z / in_proj_a / in_proj_b. Q80 ships fused in_proj_qkvz / in_proj_ba plus fix_query_key_value_ordering.
After split, both run the same conv → recurrence → gated RMSNorm → out_proj.

Pack-time fuse: interleave Q38 Q,K,V,Z into Q80 per-key-head QKVZ layout (Q128,K128,V384,Z384 for 3 values/key) and pack [b(3), a(3)] per key head into BA. Then qwen_next_qkvz_rearrange_conv_l2 and qwen_next_ba_to_decay_beta run unchanged.

Rust dispatch wrappers currently REFUSE anything but 32×128×128 (kernels/mod.rs qwen_next_gated_delta_decode_single_tcb / _at_state_offset_tcb and qwen_next_deltanet_gated_rmsnorm_tcb). Relax those gates to admit 48×128×128. Do not rewrite the Metal recurrence.

qwen80_attention_qk_norm_rope_cache hard-returns unless n_heads==16, n_kv==2, theta==5e6. qwen80_attention_apply_sigmoid_gate hard-returns unless elements==16*256. Same algorithm; open 24/4 and 24*256.
do_not_confuse_with: Mamba2. The adapter table already recorded that mamba2 is NOT this operator.
Q30 full-attention GQA. Q30 has no DeltaNet.
A new linear-attention paper. This is Gated DeltaNet, already implemented.

reuse_matrix.why: Exact Qwen3.5 law: x * rsqrt(mean(x²)+eps) * (1+weight), eps=1e-6, weight stored as delta-from-one. Hidden is 5120 not 2048; the kernel already takes hidden as a buffer.
See deliverable_2. Metal is already (heads, key_dim, value_dim). Admit 48×128×128 in the Rust wrapper (currently locked to 32×128×128).

reuse_matrix.subsystem: DeltaNet QKV conv + Q/K L2 + head repeat
reuse_matrix.why: Algorithm matches. Adapter is (1) pack-time fuse of split Q38 projections into Q80 QKVZ layout, (2) values_per_key_head=3, (3) confirm conv weight axis [10240,4,1] vs the kernel's channel*kernel indexing. Scratch in the kernel is already 128-wide; key_head_dim is 128 here too.
reuse_matrix.do_not_build: A new conv/L2 operator. Fuse weights, then call the existing kernel.

reuse_matrix.why: Kernel already takes key_heads and values_per_key_head. Pack A and B into the Q80 BA layout [key_head][b×3, a×3]. 48 value heads, not 32.
Same silu(z)*rms(x)*weight (no +1), value_head_dim=128. Rust wrapper hardcodes heads=32; open heads=48. Metal already takes heads.

Same GQA + q/k RMSNorm(+1) + partial RoPE 64/256 + sigmoid gate + o_proj. Q38 is 24Q/4KV, θ=1e7. The Q80 shader intentionally early-returns unless 16/2/θ=5e6. mha_decode_f32 itself is generic. Open the geometry lock; do not rewrite softmax attention.

Identical rule: GQA iff (layer+1)%4==0. Parameterize LAYERS=64, DELTANET=48, GQA=16. Slot formulas slot_dn=layer-layer/4 and slot_gqa=layer/4 still hold. DELETE the 14-dispatch MoE suffix; replace with a dense SwiGLU suffix (see MLP).
reuse_matrix.do_not_build: A new scheduler. Do not start from qwen_dense.rs.

reuse_matrix.why: They are ordinary GEMVs. Adapter is (a) Q38 name map language_model.model.layers.N.linear_attn.in_proj_{qkv,z,a,b} / self_attn.{q,k,v,o}_proj, (b) pack-time fuse of the four linear in-projs into the Q80 QKVZ/BA slots the existing mixer prefix expects, (c) row counts (q_proj 12288, qkv 10240, z 6144).
reuse_matrix.do_not_build: New matvec math. Reuse the representation the first pack actually emits (uniform Q4 or complete-binary).

reuse_matrix.why: Config attn_output_gate=true, output_gate_type=swish (sigmoid in the Qwen3.5 source). Gate is the second half of each q_proj head. Same as Q80. Unlock elements==24*256 (currently 16*256).

Every layer is a dense silu-SwiGLU: down(silu(gate(x))*up(x)), shapes 17408×5120 / 5120×17408. This is qwen_dense / Q30 non-expert FFN, NOT the Q80 routed/shared expert wave. Compose those kernels as the hybrid-graph suffix in place of the 14 MoE dispatches.
reuse_matrix.do_not_build: A new activation. Do not call qwen80_all_ten_routed_wave_* or qwen80_shared_expert_wave_*.

reuse_matrix.why: Same gather. Shape [248320, 5120] vs Q80 [151936, 2048]. The token-graph currently asserts the Q80 shape — parameterize that assert. Prefix is language_model.model.embed_tokens.weight.
tie_word_embeddings=false. Separate 248320×5120 matrix (~1.27B params). Same terminal GEMV. Do not share rows with embed.

tokenizer_class is Qwen2Tokenizer. Hawking already loads HF tokenizer.json. eos <|im_end|> and <|endoftext|> (ids 248046, 248044) are already in EOG_TOKEN_STRINGS. Vision special tokens exist in the vocab but are unused on the text path.
16 GQA slots, layout [seq][kv_head][256]. kv_heads=4 not 2. Cap first context well below 262144 (128 KiB/token).
Same arena: 48 conv+recurrent slots, state [head][128][128] f32. Resize heads 32→48 and slot count 36→48. Offset helper already exists so a later layer cannot silently reuse slot 0.

Keep the 9-dispatch mixer prefixes. Replace the 14-dispatch MoE suffix with ~4 dense FFN dispatches (post-norm, gate, up+swiglu, down, residual). Hidden/head counts change buffer sizes only. Do not copy Q80's 23-dispatch full-layer contract.
sample_topk_topp / sample_argmax_f32 already take n. First coherent gate should be greedy argmax, then the published top-k/top-p.
Session, streaming, interrupt, cwd binding, tools are model-agnostic. Need one new Engine impl that speaks the existing Engine/HCLI provider surface. Do not grow a parallel server.
reuse_matrix.do_not_build: A one-off shell around the model.

reuse_matrix.why: Reuse the harness and the ledger schema. Do not open a Q38 kernel tournament or a giant capture. First numbers will be DIRTY_ENGINEERING until a clean GPU window exists. This lane measured nothing.

Retarget an existing packer to the Q38 name map and language-only tensor set. 3 BPW is legal. Q4 is the cheapest first body if the packer already works. BF16 layer-major is the oracle, not the product.
reuse_matrix.do_not_build: A sub-bit campaign, a kernel tournament, or a new codec family.

reuse_matrix.why: Q38 text_config has multimodal RoPE (mrope_section [11,11,10], interleaved, θ=1e7). For text-only, transformers copies the 1D position onto the T/H/W planes; apply_interleaved_mrope is then a no-op and the result is ordinary partial RoPE. Unlock θ and head counts on the existing kernel. Do not implement vision mrope in v1.
reuse_matrix.do_not_build: A 3-component vision RoPE for the developer text path.

reuse_matrix.why: This model is dense. Every Q80 wall this session (expert residency, first-touch upload, top-k serializer) is absent. Porting any of it is wasted work and a contamination risk.
Census already refuted Q30 compatibility. qwen_dense is GQA+SwiGLU only — no hybrid schedule, no DeltaNet state. Steal SwiGLU/RMSNorm kernels from it; do not host the model there.

reuse_matrix.why_skip: See deliverable_3_vision_decision. No Hawking ViT/Qwen3-VL encoder exists. Building one is a research program. Steer §44 forbids that.
reuse_matrix.why_new_if_ever: 27-layer Qwen3-VL ViT (patch 16, temporal 2, hidden 1152, merger to 5120, gelu_pytorch_tanh). Nothing in hawking-core implements it. Do not pretend qwen_dense or DeltaNet covers it.

reuse_matrix.why_skip: text_config.mtp_num_hidden_layers=1 but this checkpoint has 0 mtp.* tensors (official Qwen3.5-27B does). Transformers ignores ^mtp.* on load. Decode does not need it.
reuse_matrix.why_new_if_ever: Official MTP is a separate decoder layer + fc. No Hawking MTP host exists. Do not invent one for this abliterated snapshot.

new_implementation_required_only_if_scop.why_nothing_fits: No ViT, no 3D patch embed, no Qwen3-VL merger, no deepstack path in hawking-core. vision_tower.* is a disjoint 333-tensor organ.
Not present in this checkpoint. Official mtp.layers.0 + mtp.fc has no Hawking counterpart. Not needed for next-token decode.

do_not_build_already_present: causal conv + Q/K L2 + head repeat
GQA + q/k norm + partial RoPE + sigmoid gate
any Q80 expert table or routed-wave kernel

deliverable_3_vision_decision.reason: This is a DEVELOPER model (S002 §3). Text-only saves 0.92 GB bf16 (0.17 GB at 3 BPW), skips a 27-layer ViT with no Hawking host, and unblocks HCLI. Vision is a later optional organ, not the special-unit critical path.

evidence.claim: Transformers exposes a text-only class that does not construct the vision tower.
evidence.quote: Use Qwen3_5ForCausalLM for text-only generation with Qwen3_5TextConfig; use Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration … to feed interleaved image/video + text.

evidence.claim: Qwen3_5TextModel.forward never references visual weights. It embed_tokens → 64 decoder layers → final RMSNorm → (caller) lm_head.

This checkpoint partitions tensors into two disjoint prefixes. language_model.* = 851 tensors / 26.896B params. vision_tower.* = 333 tensors / 0.461B params. No language_model tensor name contains visual/vision/merger.
Official Qwen3.5-27B uses the same split (model.language_model.* vs model.visual.*). The MLX conversion only renamed visual → vision_tower and language_model.model.
deepstack_visual_indexes is empty. No extra text-layer visual residual injection in this config.

language_model_only is false on the multimodal wrapper, but that flag does not pull vision weights into the text forward. Loading language_model.* only is sufficient for Qwen3_5ForCausalLM-equivalent decode.
evidence.source: bf16/config.json language_model_only=false; modeling_qwen3_5.py Qwen3_5Model.visual is only used by get_image_features / get_video_features

evidence.claim: For text-only RoPE, identical T/H/W position streams make interleaved mrope a no-op. No vision position machinery is required.

deliverable_3_vision_decision.when_to_revisit: Only after SPECIAL_UNIT_READY on text. Not this session. Steer §44.

bring_up_plan.authority: S002 §6: census → reuse existing runtime → conservative representation → complete native token → coherent generation → perf cleanup → HCLI → tools → AgentOS → Grok. Then STOP.
anti_scope: GPU belongs to Q80/DSV4F until a non-contaminating window

ordered_steps.name: geometry authority (STATIC/CPU)
ordered_steps.reuse: Clone qwen80_48_layer_execution_schedule.rs → qwen38_64_layer_execution_schedule.rs. Same interval-4 mixer rule. 48 DN slots + 16 GQA slots. Dense-MLP suffix, not MoE.
ordered_steps.also: Config parser that accepts qwen3_5 / qwen3_5_text and REFUSES qwen3_next, qwen3_moe, qwen3. Tensor name map for language_model.model.layers.*. Pack-time fuse in_proj_qkv+z → QKVZ, in_proj_b+a → BA.
ordered_steps.do_not: Open a new operator. Do not compile GPU kernels in a Q80/DSV window if it would relink shared Metal libs under their feet — prefer a later non-contaminating compile.

ordered_steps.name: conservative representation
ordered_steps.reuse: qwen_complete_binary/uniform_q4.rs or source BF16 layer-major (qwen80_source_bf16_layer_major.rs as the template).
ordered_steps.policy: Language-only. Skip vision_tower.*. Skip mtp (absent). 3 BPW legal. Prefer Q4 if the packer retargets in hours, not days. Q3 next if already supported. Never start 2-bit.
ordered_steps.resident: Q4 language ≈ 13.45 GB; Q3 ≈ 10.09 GB. Both fit beside the Q80 13.4 GiB artifact on 96 GB if inference is paused during clean Q80/DSV benches.

ordered_steps.name: complete native token
ordered_steps.reuse: qwen80_hybrid_token_graph.rs with MoE suffix deleted and SwiGLU spliced. Relax Rust geometry locks (32→48 DN heads; GQA 16/2/5e6 → 24/4/1e7).
ordered_steps.correctness: Bit-identity or a stated numeric gate against a CPU/transformers text-only oracle on layer-0 DeltaNet, layer-3 GQA, then one full token. 0 fallbacks. Do not weaken Q80 gates to make Q38 pass — fork the wrappers.
ordered_steps.gpu: Only in a non-contaminating window. Wrap any GPU run in ./tools/gpu_lane_lock.sh qwen38-reuse-matrix …

ordered_steps.name: coherent generation
ordered_steps.gate: Greedy decode of a short developer prompt produces readable, on-topic text. Then enable top_k=20 top_p=0.95. This is the product gate, not 100 TPS / TG3 / <=1.5.
ordered_steps.identity: Pin PocketAiHub Qwen3.8-27B-Abliterated-MLX + base revision 1d4bf0f2. Abliteration is a weight fact, not an architecture change.

ordered_steps.name: perf cleanup (cheap only)
ordered_steps.cap: Stop at interactive-enough (S002 §9: 5/10/20/30/50 TPS if cheap). No occupancy research program. No third campaign.
ordered_steps.labeling: DIRTY_ENGINEERING while other lanes run. CLEAN_CANDIDATE only after a locked GPU window with ≥3 alternating paired reps. Report ns/token.

ordered_steps.name: HCLI server
ordered_steps.reuse: hide-backend hcli.rs + hawking-serve. Persistent daemon, session, stream, interrupt, resume, cwd, model identity, generation params.
ordered_steps.do_not: curl-only wrapper as the finished product (S002 §10).

ordered_steps.name: tools + AgentOS + Grok
ordered_steps.reuse: Existing typed tool plane and HCLI AgentOS path. Qwen3.8 must launch Grok contracts and consume results without Claude in the loop (S002 §16-18).
ordered_steps.stop: Once SPECIAL_UNIT_READY (S002 §24) is met: FREEZE special-unit engineering and use the model.

negative_science_honored: Q80 expert machinery is irrelevant here (dense).
Q30 static <=1.5 / Q30 paths are not a template.
Do not assume 'simply bandwidth-bound' for later Q38 perf work.
Suspect immutable-identity recomputation (SHA, st_dev, geometry parse, manifest scan) as soon as a token is slow — do not start a kernel tournament.
